based_on.note: Endpoint definition and tick hard cap are copied from the frozen #99 control plan and must not change to chase a reproduction number.

mode_switch.gates: the production lifecycle store probes (5 phase stores, mDead removal store, recycle guard/commit pair) and their lvz.lifecycle-event.v2 records
mode_switch.not_gated: lifecycle persistence adapter (LVZ_LIFECYCLE_RECORDING=1 in both probe arms) and the ZombieInitialize v1 probe/legacy lvz.spawn.v1 projection

modes.name: off
modes.purpose: same build installs no new store probes; manifest lifecycle_probes.enabled=false; no v2 records

modes.name: on
modes.purpose: store probes installed; manifest lifecycle_probes.enabled=true with sites/build/session; v2 facts recorded through the single drain

limitations: the off/on contrast measures the probe installation effect on one build; no claim is made about a build without any recorder parts
probe presence can perturb timing, so every trajectory comparison is reported as equality or first divergence, never as a hard pass
phase/mDead/recycle facts are observed at store granularity; they do not by themselves prove the caller branch or the kill cause

comparisons.name: control_repeatability
comparisons.require: common boundary/state/RNG/action equality within the frozen window
comparisons.limits: facts, counters and sequence values are never stripped

comparisons.name: probe_repeatability
comparisons.require: common boundary/state/RNG/action equality plus valid v2 probe receipts and healthy counters in both on children
comparisons.limits: raw phase/removal/recycle facts are compared by sequence, never deduplicated

comparisons.name: probe_installation_effect
comparisons.require: strict audit (captured state/render/engine-call/particle) AND strict action/request/result AND initial/final outcome equality, or a located first difference; the v2 probe stream and probe counters are compared separately
comparisons.limits: v2-only facts are expected in the on arm and are reported as the intended difference

verdicts: capture completeness: valid lifecycle receipts plus strict closed audit for every expected child run; probe arms additionally require the lifecycle_probes capability and zero blocking counters
probe installation effect: probe-off vs probe-on equality or first divergence with range (never instrumentation-free non-perturbation)
two-run repeatability: off-a vs off-b and on-a vs on-b on common evidence

first-kill sufficiency: reported by tools/issue111_lifecycle_report.py from raw v2 facts (earlier unclassified removal blocks the proof); false while no death-confirming capture exists in the frozen window
forbidden: overwriting or modifying the four issue #99 trajectories, reports or seals
starting more than one game process at a time
changing stop_when, tick_budget or the declared endpoint after seeing results
installing death/removal/recycle hooks before the candidate-review gate closes
claiming instrumentation off/on from the persistence switch
treating event-stream differences alone as an instrumentation failure or as a gameplay fork
claiming a full-window first kill without death/removal capture and call-internal ordering
required_reviews: principal review of the hosted-build configuration correction and the four hosted single-cold trajectories before live execution
maintainer review before any change to hosted script behavior or native lifecycle hooks
commands: python tools/issue111_lifecycle_experiment.py --root . prepare --name issue111-d-hosted-v2-off-a --plan experiments/plans/issue99-shovel-control.json --mode on --probes off --single-cold --skip-build --hosted-build build/hosted-build.json

python tools/issue111_lifecycle_experiment.py --root . prepare --name issue111-d-hosted-v2-on-a --plan experiments/plans/issue99-shovel-control.json --mode on --probes on --single-cold --skip-build --hosted-build build/hosted-build.json

python tools/issue111_lifecycle_experiment.py --root . prepare --name issue111-d-hosted-v2-off-b --plan experiments/plans/issue99-shovel-control.json --mode on --probes off --single-cold --skip-build --hosted-build build/hosted-build.json

python tools/issue111_lifecycle_experiment.py --root . prepare --name issue111-d-hosted-v2-on-b --plan experiments/plans/issue99-shovel-control.json --mode on --probes on --single-cold --skip-build --hosted-build build/hosted-build.json
command_notes: every prepare arm pins both switches: --mode on keeps LVZ_LIFECYCLE_RECORDING=1 in both probe arms, --probes off/on is the real LVZ_LIFECYCLE_PROBES switch, and --single-cold limits each arm to its one source trajectory (-s42-c0); no extra replay or recovery child exists
the four prepared arms are exactly OFF A/B and ON A/B; report/compare read the real child run directories named in evaluation_child_mapping
one game process at a time; the runner applies LVZ_LIFECYCLE_PROBES and single-cold mode from the prepared metadata, so the ambient environment is not trusted
all four arms pin the same recorder build sha256 (--expected-recorder-sha256); check fails if a child audit declares a different build

--scope common now requires the strict audit comparison, the strict action/request/result and outcome comparison (engine_replay._trace_steps, native request cross-check when present) and fails closed if either input is missing; the lifecycle stream is compared separately only for same-mode pairs
